notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market SaaS (customer support + knowledge base). Product team evaluating Redwood: started on hosted API, ran full feature demo; moved to Dedicated POC to meet lower latency and isolation needs.

Recent timeline (high-level):
- 2026-01-12: Intro call w/ Maya (AE) + product lead (Sasha Kim). Quick hosted API demo; initial appetite.
- 2026-01-20: Deep demo — streaming chat, embeddings, reranking. SE (Diego) ran sample integration with existing vector DB.
- 2026-02-05: 2-week Hosted POC (chat + embeddings) (metrics: avg latency 300-400ms token; cost OK but bursty).
- 2026-02-22: Dedicated POC kicked off (2 reserved GPU nodes). Observed p95 latency drop to ~120ms for typical support flows; inference throughput improved 3x.
- 2026-02-25: Pricing call w/ finance — Redwood proposed 12mo reserved commit + overage model. Initial ARR estimate $150k-$300k depending on commit tier.
- 2026-03-02: Internal security questionnaire sent; Polaris legal started redlines on MSA/DPA.
- 2026-03-09: Vendor onboarding kickoff with security (Hannah + Polaris Sec Ops).

Use-case & technical requirements (as told by product lead):
- Primary workload: conversational support assistant that combines live chat + historical context via embeddings & reranking.
- Latency target: p95 <= 200ms for short-turn chat (best effort p99 <= 400ms under steady load).
- Throughput: concurrent sessions ~200 active users at peak, expected to scale to 600 in 12 months.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit if unit economics are predictable; prefers guidance on batching/quant profiles.
- Model preference: open quantized models acceptable; ask for recommended model profiles per workload.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to lower-cost model variant when capacity constrained.

Security & compliance details:
- SOC2 Type II required before signing MSA; ISO27001 nice-to-have.
- DPA: must include EU residency clause for EU customers; legal flagged cross-border processing.
- SSO: SAML + SCIM provisioning required for integration with internal IdP.
- Key management: KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated; want option to use customer-managed keys.
- Audit & retention: 1yr audit logs retained, but request option for longer retention for escalations.

Procurement/legal notes:
- Polaris legal submitted MSA redlines focusing on liability caps, IP ownership of prompts/outputs, data deletion obligations on termination. Request: add carve-outs for service data vs customer data.
- DPA: redlines around data residency + subprocessors. Polaris requires a list of subprocessors and advance notice prior to adding new ones.
- SLA: Polaris legal insists on financial remedies for downtime; Redwood SLA currently 99.9% for Dedicated. Polaris pushing for 99.95 and clearer latency SLOs for p95/p99.
- Insurance and security evidence: Polaris security wants SOC2 reports, penetration test summary, Vulnerability Disclosure Policy.

POC outcomes & feedback:
- Dedicated POC positively received — substantial latency improvement and predictable tail latency.
- Team liked Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching + quantization) but asked for concrete cost forecast table.
- Minor integration friction: KV cache behavior on reconnects; Diego filed ENG-545 for follow-up.

Sales/ops logistics:
- Finance will sign off on commit once Redwood provides a 12-month committed price schedule with clear overage rates and an exhibitable capacity matrix.
- Procurement requests a single consolidated contract (MSA + DPA + SLA) and a short playbook for onboarding (VPC peering checklist, KMS instructions, support escalation path).

Direct quotes / call paraphrases:
- "We saw the p95 drop — this is close to what our users need — but legal is being conservative on the MSA." — Sasha (VP Product) 2026-02-22
- "Need the DPA residency clause tightened or we can't route EU customers through hosted nodes." — Polaris Legal 2026-03-02

Open action items (current):
- Redwood legal to review Polaris redlines and propose counter-redline (target: 2026-03-18).
- Security deep-dive: schedule SOC2 + vendor security call w/ Polaris Sec Ops (Hannah coordinating).
- Provide pricing exhibit with commit tiers and example monthly token/throughput buckets.
- Finalize Dedicated capacity sizing doc and onboarding checklist (Diego to deliver).
